title: On-Time Delivery
definition: The fraction of delivered sales order lines that arrived on or before the committed date, excluding cancelled lines.
formula_text: SUM(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date <= committed_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) WHERE actual_delivery_date IN period AND status != 'CANCELLED'

title: On-Time In-Full
definition: The fraction of delivered sales order lines that were both on time (actual <= committed) and in full (first shipment qty >= ordered qty), excluding cancelled lines.
formula_text:
SUM(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date <= committed_date
          AND first_shipment_qty >= ordered_qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
/ COUNT(*) WHERE actual_delivery_date IN period AND status != 'CANCELLED'

title: Unit Fill Rate
definition: The ratio of units shipped on first shipment to units ordered, measured at the requested date, excluding cancelled lines. A measure of immediate availability.
formula_text: SUM(first_shipment_qty) / SUM(ordered_qty) WHERE requested_date IN period AND status != 'CANCELLED'
scor_attribute: RL.2.3 % of Orders Delivered In Full

title: Days of Inventory
definition: The number of days current on-hand inventory would last at the trailing 90-day consumption rate. Measured as a ratio of sums at the requested grouping.

title: Landed Cost Per Unit
definition: The fully loaded cost per unit of received goods, including material, freight, duty, insurance and handling, weighted by received quantity.
formula_text: SUM(material_cost + freight_allocation + duty_cost + insurance + handling) / SUM(received_qty) WHERE receipt_date IN period

title: Supplier Lead Time
definition: Median and 90th percentile calendar days from PO order date to goods receipt date.
formula_text: PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DATEDIFF(DAY, order_date, receipt_date)) and PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) ...

title: Order Fulfilment Cycle Time
definition: Median calendar days from sales order placement to customer delivery.
formula_text: PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DATEDIFF(DAY, order_date, actual_delivery_date))

title: Transit Time
definition: Median and 90th percentile hours from shipment departure to delivery.
formula_text: PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DATEDIFF(HOUR, ship_date, actual_delivery))

title: Inventory Turns
definition: The number of times inventory turns over per year, based on trailing 90-day consumption and average inventory. Invariant: inventory_turns * days_of_inventory = 365.

title: Stockout Rate
definition: Fraction of location-part-day observations where demand exists but on-hand inventory is zero.
formula_text: SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty = 0 AND allocated_qty > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)

title: Freight Cost Per Unit
definition: Freight cost per unit shipped, allocated by chargeable weight share, weighted by shipped quantity.
formula_text: SUM(freight_allocation) / SUM(shipped_qty) WHERE ship_date IN period
